title: Nigeria's National Cybercrime Centre reports arrests in investment fraud, romance scam and sextortion cases
date_note: Vanguard gives only its own publication day, 25 November, and says police briefed reporters on Wednesday; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Vanguard reports that the Nigeria Police Force's National Cybercrime Centre, led by AIG Akaniyene Ezima, briefed reporters on arrests in three cases: a text-message investment fraud, a romance scam targeting elderly Canadians, carried out jointly with the RCMP, and a sextortion and cyberstalking case. Ezima is quoted: "the victims made successful transfers amounting to ₦40,000,000.00" in the investment case. Police say investigations are ongoing.
plain: Vanguard reports Nigerian cybercrime police made arrests in an investment fraud, a romance scam and a sextortion case. Investigations are ongoing, police say.
exec: Vanguard reports Nigerian police arrests in three online fraud and extortion cases, one jointly with Canada's RCMP.
geo_basis: National Cybercrime Centre of the Nigeria Police Force, Abuja; no victim city stated
org: Nigeria Police Force National Cybercrime Centre

evidence.quote: Acting on these fraudulent representations, the victims made successful transfers amounting to ₦40,000,000.00.

validation.note: Only Vanguard read; it relays the police briefing. The headline says six arrested but the article names nine people across the cases, so no arrest count is given.
